sections.heading: Digital Smart Courses
items: Begin your learning journey with structured courses designed to build strong fundamentals and practical skills aligned with industry needs.

sections.heading: Industry Experts
items: Learn from experienced industry professionals and certified trainers who guide you with real-world insights and hands-on expertise.

sections.heading: Multiple Centers
items: Benefit from our strong institutional network, industry collaborations, and access to training opportunities across key technology hubs.

“eChipHub is a premier EdTech platform developed jointly by NIELIT and SoCTeamup Semiconductors through a strategic collaboration under the aegis of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), aiming to enhance chip design and development skills nationwide.

By leveraging open-source EDA tools, the platform delivers industry-aligned training and virtual labs, complemented by expert-led programs that equip students, researchers, and innovators with hands-on expertise. By covering the complete chip design lifecycle—from RTL to GDSII—eChipHub bridges the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application, directly supporting India’s mission for innovation and technological self-reliance”
Students trained through our academic & industry collaborations in 2025-2026.
Our hands-on workshops are designed to provide practical exposure, industry insights, and skill-based learning through expert-led sessions and real-world applications.
We provide courses that are both structured and aligned with industry standards, aimed at establishing robust technical foundations. These courses are designed to enhance learners’ problem-solving.

Explore our Virtual Labs with pre-installed open source EDA tools, reproducible e-learning resources and interactive digital environments designed to build practical skills and industry-ready knowledge in the domain of chip design.
Explore our collection of moments, events, and creative highlights captured during our journey.

sections.heading: About Us
items: A trusted national institution delivering skill development, training, and certification in electronics and information technology.

sections.heading: eChipHub
items: is a jointly developed digital initiative by
Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
Government of India, in collaboration with

The platform is envisioned to strengthen India’s capabilities in chip design, SoC development, full-stack IP creation, and open-source EDA tool adoption, contributing to long-term semiconductor self-reliance and digital sovereignty.

In an era where semiconductors underpin strategic independence and technological competitiveness, eChipHub aims to make industry-grade chip design skills accessible, scalable, and affordable for students, researchers, faculty, startups, and MSMEs across the country.

Through industry led structured training programs, cloud-based virtual labs, open source design flows, and mentorship from academia and industry, eChipHub seeks to enable participants to take their designs from RTL to GDSII using complete open and hybrid design flows.

By combining public institutional support with industry expertise, eChipHub represents a collaborative model to democratize semiconductor knowledge and build a sustainable national ecosystem for innovation.

To strengthen India’s digital ecosystem by developing a future-ready workforce equipped with practical skills, industry exposure, and nationally recognized certifications through quality education and training.
